next.reason: 1985: 'All control heading report groups are presented from the control break level down to the most minor control' (§1985:II.3.2.4.2 GR2). 2023: on a control break each control heading is printed 'in order of control levels from the level of the control break down to the lowest' (§2023:13.18.57.4 GR6), the GENERATE statement prints each control footing and control heading up to the level of the break (§2023:14.9.16.4 GR5), and 'control break processing for that level and any lower levels is performed' (§2023:13.18.16.4 GR3). The OR PAGE phrase is new syntax a 1985 program cannot write; a 1985 report prints the same headings in the same order.
